exec: pm.test('Customer: an address with a map pin (Model Town, Lahore) → 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

item.name: 5 · An order takes stock; voice; the announcement
Voice (typed): "order accept karo, bees minute" → a proposed accept

exec: pm.test('Voice (typed): "order accept karo, bees minute" → a proposed accept → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('the accept request for this order, 20 minutes', () => { pm.expect(d.proposedAction.path).to.eql('/food/vendor/orders/' + pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId') + '/accept'); pm.expect(d.proposedAction.body).to.eql({ etaMinutes: 20 }); });

item.name: Announcement (Urdu): the new order read aloud

exec: pm.test('Announcement (Urdu): the new order read aloud → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Urdu text, no TTS', () => { pm.expect(d.text).to.match(/^نیا آرڈر:/); pm.expect(d.ttsUrl).to.be.null; });
pm.test('Movements: the order took 4 eggs → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('an order movement with the code', () => pm.expect(d.items[0]).to.include({ reason: 'order', delta: -4, orderCode: pm.collectionVariables.get('orderCode') }));
pm.test('Voice (typed, stock screen): a count → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('a proposed stock count for the rice', () => { pm.expect(d.intent).to.eql('count'); pm.expect(d.proposedAction.path).to.eql('/food/vendor/kitchen/stock/count'); pm.expect(d.proposedAction.body.lines[0]).to.include({ ingredientId: pm.collectionVariables.get('riceId'), qty: 20, unit: 'kg' }); });
